purpose: Define MetaModule as a stable canonical feature/application composition identity distinct from its constituent modules, UI placement and concrete runtime instance.

topics.name: MetaModule Identity
topics.purpose: Define MetaModule as a stable canonical feature/application composition identity distinct from its constituent modules, UI placement and concrete runtime instance.

semantics.identity_rule: Every MetaModule has an explicit stable canonical identity.
semantics.composition_rule: MetaModule identity names the composition/application semantics, not any one constituent module.
semantics.constituent_rule: Constituent UserModules, schemas, resources, operations and views retain their own canonical identities.
semantics.placement_rule: nanoCMS site/page placement is a binding and never MetaModule semantic identity.
semantics.runtime_rule: Concrete runtime activation/instance identity is separate from MetaModule definition identity.
semantics.path_rule: File/directory path is discovery metadata and never canonical MetaModule identity.
semantics.authority_rule: MetaModule existence/visibility does not grant access to constituent capabilities.

invariants.rule: A MetaModule is an explicit composition of existing semantic capabilities; composition, placement or runtime activation never silently transfers ownership, identity or authority from constituent modules/resources.

hard_gates.condition: MetaModule identity inferred from page route
runtime instance reused as definition identity

references.purpose: MetaModules use the common explicit composition model.

prose.summary: Define MetaModule as a stable canonical feature/application composition identity distinct from its constituent modules, UI placement and concrete runtime instance.
notes: Unlocked pending reconciliation against composition, nanoCMS, UserModule, Editor and runtime activation contracts.
